competitions.name: Geeta Chitrakala
competitions.subtitle: Global Drawing & Painting Competition
competitions.description: Express the wisdom of the Geeta through handmade drawing and painting. Create one final physical artwork and let your colours speak the shlokas.
highlights: Handmade physical artwork — one final entry per participant
Top 3 per age group · Top 10 merit · participation certificate for valid entries

competitions.name: Geeta Swar
competitions.subtitle: Shloka · Meaning · Life Application Challenge
competitions.description: Recite a shloka, share its meaning and its application in your life — as a 60–180 second public Instagram Reel.
highlights: Multiple reels allowed — your highest-reach eligible reel is final
Top 3 per age group · Top 10 merit · participation certificate for valid entries

competitions.name: Geeta Gyan Challenge
competitions.subtitle: 50 Questions · 18 Chapters · One Golden Challenge
competitions.description: A grand online quiz spanning all 18 chapters of the Bhagavad Geeta — 50 questions, 35 minutes, one scored attempt.
highlights: Ranked by score, with difficulty-based tie-breaks; time only as final tie-break
Top 3 excellence · Top 10 merit · participation certificate at 50%+ score

competitions.name: Geeta Expression
competitions.subtitle: 60-sec Personal Reflection Challenge
competitions.description: Share a heartfelt 60-second personal reflection on how the Geeta touches your life, as a public Instagram Reel.
highlights: Ideal 60 sec, max 90 sec — multiple reels allowed
Top 3 per age group · Top 10 merit · one participation certificate per valid participant

competitions.name: Vivechan Reel
competitions.subtitle: Creative Edit Challenge
competitions.description: Craft a 30–60 second creative edit from the approved Vivechan Timestamp Bank and publish it as a public Instagram Reel.
competitions.participants: Open to all · no age-category judging
competitions.window: Create 4 – 16 Sep · Publish 17 – 18 Sep · cut-off 25 Sep
highlights: 30–60 sec reel from the approved Timestamp Bank · master MP4 required
Overall Top 3 · up to Top 50 merit · participation certificate for valid entries
